fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head (go build -trimpath) and ran rhiza run start --foreground --workflow plan by hand in a scratch repo with a bare origin and fake rex/claude/gh (plan-workflow-merge-main-moved.txtar's). With origin/main moved once after rebased-green: merge (visit 1) failed with 'Not merged: origin/main has moved past PR #7's checked head', went to rebase; rebase (visit 2) pushed a head on the new main, merge (visit 2) made the only gh pr merge call, pinned with --match-head-commit to that head (which contains the other commit), close-out passed and the run succeeded. With origin/main moving on every check: merge failed at visits 1-3 with no gh pr merge call, and the run ended failed with 'step "rebase" went over max_visits 3'. rhiza workflow describe plan shows merge on.fail -> rebase. TestPlanBuiltin and the plan-workflow-merge-main-moved, plan-workflow-pr and run-ship-merge-main-moved scripts pass. The rendered-only conflict path of ship rebase was not exercised.
